notes: Batch b44: BBF -- Bigger, Better, Faster (Schwarzer et al. 2023) -- the paper's recipe whole, as written, on Snake (algos/bbf/, plans/algoExploration/d-data-efficiency.md section 7; docs/runs.md b44). Asked for 2026-09-20 to read how the algorithm itself does on this game, separate from b43's reset-alone probe. SNEK_ALGO=bbf at its defaults, which are the paper's: dueling C51 (51 atoms on [-10, 110]) on fc 1280,2048 (the MLP analogue of the x4 IMPALA encoder plus the 2048 dense layer), replay ratio 8 at batch 32, AdamW lr 1e-4 eps 1.5e-4 weight decay 0.1, gradient clip 10, EMA target tau 0.005 every step, SPR K 5 weight 5 (transition width 256, projection 512), shrink-and-perturb resets every 40k gradient steps at alpha 0.5 with n-step 10 -> 3 and gamma 0.97 -> 0.997 over the 10k gradient steps after each reset, epsilon 1 -> 0 over 2,001 moves after a 2,000-move prefill at epsilon 1, PER 0.5, 1M replay, one lane. The n-step return is summed when a batch is drawn, from a sequential replay, so the anneal reaches every drawn transition as in the paper's code. Reward: hist8, the b2 preset with step penalty 0.01, food distance 0, and the potential shaping OFF -- the reward/discount coupling is exact under a sample-time anneal only with it off. Reward unclipped (the series' rule). Cap 100k moves, the paper's regime: at one lane that is 100k counted steps and about 800k gradient steps, about nine hours of learning an arm at the laptop's measured 25 gradient steps/s (1 thread) before stage A. Gates (2026-09-20): tests/test_bbf.py 25 tests, tests/mut_bbf.json 18 of 18; a smoke with resets every 2,000 gradient steps checkpointed, resumed with its buffer and restored through evaluate.py; the whole suite (1,442 tests) passes. Prediction (agent): the stage-A trace saw-tooths at every reset (every 5k moves, 20 in the run) and the perfect rate at 100k moves stays under 20% on every seed, no checkpoint at 97, stage B empty; the SPR loss falls within the first cycle and stays low. If a seed reaches 50% the recipe has done in 100k moves what b35's paper cells could not in 10M. No control cell: read against b35's paper cells and b43 for shape only. Unpinned; either box claims the wave of 4.
